evidence_excerpts: A complex is a subset S having Φ>0 that is not included within a larger subset having higher Φ.
To the extent that consciousness corresponds to the capacity to integrate information, complexes are the “subjects” of experience, being the locus where information can be integrated.
text: A complex is an integrated subset with Φ greater than zero that is not contained in a larger subset with higher Φ, and complexes are the loci of subjective experience.
